style.toneOfVoiceUnformatted: Make your Christmas extra special and beautiful this year by celebrating the season with this artificial tree from HOMCOM. Covered in snow flecks and adorned with a variety of red berries and pinecones, this tree creates a festive atmosphere. The 6ft size is suitable for different room sizes and spaces, featuring a tall top branch perfect for your tree topper. The tree comes complete with a removable base, ensuring stability and balance. Key features include 678 plastic branch tips for a full, life-like look, a large removable base for added balance, and a design filled with berries and pinecones for a luxurious finish. It also has a top branch for your star or angel. It is suggested to spend 25-30 minutes spreading out the branches to achieve the fullest appearance. The tree is green in color, made from PVC, PE, and steel materials. Its overall dimensions are F109 x 180H cm, with a height of 6ft and a tip count of 678 (625 PVC, 53 PE). Please note, UK mainland delivery only.
